items.justification: Update timeliness and monitoring for model behaviour drift pursue different objectives.
Key uniqueness and input sanitisation are unrelated controls.
Generation of unique device keys is unrelated to secure disposal of assets on transfer of ownership.
Cryptographic strength of authentication mechanisms and matching system usage to data sensitivity are different objectives.
Both require assurance over externally sourced capability; A by using reviewed implementations, B by due diligence on the provider.
Password generation strength and least-privilege permissions between systems are unrelated controls.
B's training duty explicitly names preventing and mitigating vulnerabilities, the same defect class A requires be monitored and rectified.
Key lifecycle management and matching system usage to data sensitivity share no objective.
Secure development practice and independent security testing are distinct assurance activities in one development lifecycle.
Acting on disclosed vulnerabilities and re-testing after a major version change are distinct duties within vulnerability handling.
Version control of artefacts and publication of hashes that let recipients verify them are two halves of artefact integrity.
Automatic update activation is unrelated to threat modelling triggered by configuration changes.
B names configuration changes as its risk domain, which is the same domain A addresses through user setup guidance.
Both reduce exposure through network-reachable interfaces; A by disabling unused ones, B by controlling abuse of the exposed API.
Informing end users of a required update is unrelated to internal employee risk reporting.
B's audit trail explicitly supports security auditing and incident response, the activity A mandates be carried out continuously.
Password generation and superfluous model functionality are unrelated risks.
Password generation strength has no bearing on asset disposal at transfer of ownership.
Both limit what a system can reach; A restricts network connectivity once compromise is detected, B restricts permissions granted in advance.
Using evaluated cryptographic implementations is unrelated to the up-front business case and risk documentation.
Publishing a support period and sanitising training inputs share no objective.
Transport cryptography and due diligence on external components are unrelated controls.
Timely action on disclosed vulnerabilities differs from risk assessment performed when adopting an external component.
Guidance for checking secure configuration and transparency about data handling pursue different objectives.
User-facing setup guidance is unrelated to the developer's up-front risk assessment.
Providing updates and holding unique keys with which their authenticity can be checked are distinct parts of one secure update chain.
Both require detection of security-relevant change in a running system; A on the device through integrity alerts, B through continuous infrastructure monitoring.
Communications cryptography and superfluous model functionality are unrelated risks.
Releasing the fix promptly and telling users about it are distinct duties in one update process.
Receiving vulnerability reports and distributing the resulting patches are the intake and output ends of one vulnerability handling process.
Device-level alerting on unauthorized change differs from organizational communication of unresolved threats.
Key uniqueness and threat communication to stakeholders share no objective.
Both require accessible user-facing information about the product; A the support period, B guidance for use and configuration.
Unauthorized change detection is unrelated to asset disposal at transfer of ownership.
Key uniqueness and matching system usage to data sensitivity are unrelated controls.
Both mandate secure removal of data assets; A user data on the device at the user's request, B training data and models at transfer of ownership.
B names data poisoning as what its log analysis detects; A prevents the same class of manipulation at the input. Prevention and detection of one threat.
Rectifying vulnerabilities oneself and obtaining assurance that responsible external parties will do so are distinct parts of one remediation duty.
Checking for available updates is unrelated to pre-release security testing.
Both govern the credentials and controls protecting access to system assets; A mandates per-device uniqueness, B mandates evaluation of the access control framework.
